case.summary: Case HHG-004 was initiated following an alert and customer dispute from customer C08106 regarding an unauthorized $128.33 online transaction (txn 3583227) on card C08106-K1 on 2016-12-29. The transaction for product C deviated significantly from the historical baseline of 209 prior transactions averaging $35.31 (z=3.3) and originated from a newly identified device (firefox 47.0, D001320). A supervised fraud model calculated a calibrated fraud probability of 0.93, consistent with card-not-present fraud patterns. Based on the customer confirmation, behavioral anomaly, and model scoring, the incident is confirmed as fraud with an exposure of $128.33.
